# Dmitriy Shakhmatov
## Dmitriy Shakhmatov
### Signature
**Dmitriy Shakhmatov** , commonly known as **Dima** , is a Ukrainian former Hot Wheels designer who worked for Mattel from 2014 to 2023. His last position at Mattel was as design manager for Hot Wheels, serving in that position from 2017. He was last part of the Premium department; prior to that he was in charge of the $1 lineup.
